about: Paradise is a town on Newfoundland and Labrador’s Avalon Peninsula, inland from Conception Bay South and southwest of St. John’s. It grew rapidly as a residential suburb of the capital, with new subdivisions, big-box retail along Topsail Road, and remaining ponds and bog edges. It is one of the province’s fastest-growing communities. About 23,000 people live in Paradise.
